landing.title: What did you learn today?
landing.subtitle: Narau helps you answer that, every day. Each morning a curator files one well-sourced card on your desk — a single Wikipedia reading from the areas you care about. Read it, stamp it learned, and watch your drawer of learning grow, one new thing at a time.
landing.sampleTitle: The quiet invention of the card catalogue
landing.sampleBody: Before search, before the web, a librarian's drawer held every subject in the world — one card, one idea, one careful cross-reference at a time.
landing.step1Body: Choose the areas you want to read about — science, history, art, and more.
landing.step2Body: One carefully selected reading per day, curated and attributed from Wikipedia.
landing.step3Body: Finish the card, stamp it learned, and watch your drawer of learning grow.
